$comment: Work e2er's parts are based on, draw from or cite: the creator, the role, the relation, the work's title and address, when it was published and read, and where it was found. This is the credit data for e2er.org's catalogue: a `based_on` entry is cited on the part's page as "Based on" with a link to the work; its authors are cited as the source and get no page of their own on e2er.org. Templates carry the same entries in their own [[credit]] tables; tests/test_fieldmap_template.py keeps the two equal. A credit says where an idea came from; it does not say its authors endorse the part.

template:field-map.title: Map a research field with Claude: main path analysis, step by step
